patterns.note: Sections alternate between a deep dark blue background and a light off-white background, creating clear visual separation and rhythm.
Prominent display headings use an elegant serif typeface, while body text and smaller UI elements use a clean, modern sans-serif, creating a sophisticated contrast.

A primary palette of deep dark blue and crisp white is accented with a subtle, bright green for key data points and calls to action, providing visual emphasis without overwhelming the minimalist aesthetic.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, ensuring constant access to key links.
Complex data and processes are broken down into digestible, card-based sections with clear headings and concise explanations, often accompanied by illustrative charts or input fields.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent navigation. Content sections simply scroll into view without any complex reveal animations or parallax effects.

The visual design relies on strong typographic contrast, pairing a large, elegant serif font for headlines with a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy, set against high-contrast background colors.
Information is presented in distinct, well-padded sections, often using a card-like structure with subtle rounded corners and light background fills to group related content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) provide a strong visual anchor, complemented by clear, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, uppercase labels for hierarchy.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a classic, elegant serif typeface for its large headings, combined with a deep, sophisticated dark blue background, elevates the brand beyond typical financial services, conveying a sense of luxury and trustworthiness. The integration of clean, modern data visualizations within this aesthetic is particularly well-executed.
